description: Give AgentJido a complete, safe, observable path for receiving and sending DelveTown likes. Recognize incoming likes without treating them as direct requests. Select outgoing likes under explicit eligibility rules and a separate budget. Support scheduled and manual proactive review, visible dry-run proposals, operator-approved publication, idempotent effects, and verified live QA. Keep protocol writes off by default and do not enable automatic live likes as part of this epic.
title: Complete controlled like participation
